text: Fall classes start late this year: the first day of classes is September 9, a full week after move-in, so students are on campus with nothing scheduled (reaction: restless boredom). Sidechat posts: "why did I move in a week early just to sit in my room"; "campus is a ghost town until classes actually start"; "a whole week of orientation icebreakers before a single lecture, incredible"; "counting down to syllabus week like it's a holiday".

Dorm room views: students posting their windows facing a brick wall a few feet away (reaction: rueful complaint). Sidechat posts: "my Carman window faces a wall, I get zero sunlight"; "paid twelve thousand dollars for a view of bricks"; "my roommate got the window with the skyline and I got the airshaft"; "you can tell which side of the building you're on by whether you know what time of day it is".

Course registration: students checking CULPA and Rate My Professor before enrolling in a section (reaction: uncertainty). Sidechat posts: "is Prof. Hinds' section actually that bad or is everyone just dramatic"; "CULPA reviews for the intro stats sections contradict each other completely"; "spent three hours reading professor reviews instead of just picking one"; "everyone in my dorm has a spreadsheet comparing sections".

Vergil's course search is broken during registration: it returns nothing unless the exact course name is typed, so students cannot find the classes they want (reaction: frustration). Sidechat posts: "Vergil demands the exact course name like it's a password"; "Vergil is hiding the classes I actually want"; "searched 'stats' and got 0 results, searched 'Introduction to Statistics' and got 40"; "how is the course search worse than it was last year".

Uris Pool is closed for maintenance during the first weeks of the semester, right when students planned to start swimming again (reaction: deflated annoyance). Sidechat posts: "went to Uris at 7 for my first swim of the year and it's closed for maintenance"; "maintenance on the pool the week everyone comes back, classic"; "the one facility I actually use is the one they shut"; "what does a pool even need maintained, it's water".

Campus gate restrictions: the gates are on restricted access and students have to show a CUID at the entrances, wait at the turnstiles, and cannot bring friends from other schools onto campus (reaction: irritation at being policed on their own campus). Sidechat posts: "had to show my ID three times to walk from Butler to my dorm"; "the gates are supposed to keep us safe, they mostly keep us in line"; "my friend from NYU couldn't come to my room because the gates"; "nothing says welcome back like a turnstile".

Move-in: students unloading cars and hauling boxes into the dorms, discovering the rooms are smaller than they planned for and deciding what actually gets to stay (reaction: overwhelmed, sweaty resignation). Sidechat posts: "brought a mini-fridge, a rug, and a lamp and the room fits one of them"; "my parents packed like I was moving into a house"; "carried four boxes up five floors and the elevator was reserved for someone else"; "deciding which of my possessions makes the cut".

NSOP (New Student Orientation Program) is running its official welcome sessions for first-years while seniors on Sidechat post the warnings the sessions leave out (reaction: jaded amusement from upperclassmen, mild alarm from first-years). Sidechat posts: "NSOP will not tell you that the 1 train stops running when you need it most"; "orientation says 'explore the city', seniors say 'Butler is your city now'"; "they gave us a campus tour and skipped every building that matters"; "freshmen asking NSOP leaders questions the leaders learned the hard way".
